The Title Vivana

Condominium in Kamala
HomeSaleThe Title Vivana

Project overview

Four seven-storey residential buildings in Kamala with an Italian coastal style, 306 units in total and a shuttle to Kamala Beach.

Units range from 30 sqm 1-bedroom layouts up to 3-bedroom penthouses. Prices and availability on request via WhatsApp.

The Title Vivana: key facts

  • The Title Vivana is a condominium in Kamala, Phuket, developed by Rhom Bho Property PLC (The Title).
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 30–128.5 sqm.
  • Construction status: pre-sale; completion listed as Apr 2029.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿4,201,101.
  • Nearest beach: Kamala Beach (2.1 km / 6 minutes, driving).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (800 m, straight line); Patong Hospital (6.1 km, straight line); Big C (1.4 km, straight line); Tesco Lotus (4.1 km, straight line).
  • More projects by Rhom Bho Property in our catalogue: Darayana Kamala, The Title Cocoon, The Title Adora Rawai, Biancana, Casa De Monte, Coralina Kamala.
